36.0.en: We watched the [[night:night]] come in through the window and thought of the market that [[flourish:flourishes]] after dark.
36.0.zh: 我们看着夜色从窗外漫进来，又想起那处市集：天一黑才真正兴旺起来。

36.1.en: To [[succeed:succeed]] in a place like this, the man on the screen said, you must start small.
36.1.zh: 屏幕上那个人说，想在这样的地方成功，就得从小处做起。

36.2.en: The [[prospect:prospect]] ahead looked bright to Father, even where the [[mist:mist]] sat in low grey waves.
36.2.zh: 在父亲看来，前头的前景一片明亮，哪怕雾正低低地堆成灰色的浪。

36.3.en: By the end of the news, the [[host:host]] had given us votes and Father had given me a fresh [[perspective:perspective]].
36.3.zh: 新闻放完，主持人留下的还是选票，父亲却给了我一个全新的视角。

36.4.en: When the ride home turned [[quiet:quiet]] again, Father put his whole [[viewpoint:viewpoint]] into three short lines.
36.4.zh: 回程又静下来时，父亲只用了短短三句话，就说完了自己的全部看法。

36.5.en: You could hear Father's [[standpoint:standpoint]] clearly in the [[story:story]] he told us within sight of home.
36.5.zh: 父亲的立场，在他望见家门时讲的那段故事里，听得清清楚楚。

37.0.en: Father said our bright [[outlook:outlook]] for the year could be read in the mountains and rivers we passed.
37.0.zh: 父亲说，我们这一年的好前景，从沿途的山河里就看得出来。

37.1.en: Father wrote one line at the top of his page as a [[guideline:guideline]] for the whole [[trip:trip]].
37.1.zh: 父亲在纸页最上头写了一行字，作为整趟旅程的指导方针。

37.2.en: Our family [[ethic:ethic]] is short enough to say in one [[sentence:sentence]]: work hard and be kind.
37.2.zh: 我们家的处世准则一句话就能说完：踏实做事，善待他人。

37.3.en: Father said that after our long [[night:night]] ride, he needed no one to [[advise:advise]] him anymore.
37.3.zh: 父亲说，熬过那趟长长的夜车，他再也不需要谁来给他出主意了。

37.4.en: Everyone at the table laughed and said yes to Father's simple [[proposal:proposal]].
37.4.zh: 桌边的每个人都笑了，痛痛快快地答应了父亲那个简单的提议。

37.5.en: Rain on the inn windows sent us hunting the menu for a [[hint:hint]] of honey.
37.5.zh: 雨点敲着小店的窗，我们翻遍菜单，想找一丝带蜂蜜的线索。

38.0.en: The train pulled out at [[sunrise:sunrise]], and Father [[declare:declared]] the journey begun.
38.0.zh: 列车在日出时分驶出，父亲宣布旅程开始了。

38.1.en: Father [[affirm:affirmed]] his [[promise:promise]] again, quietly, while the sun lit the whole [[plain:plain]].
38.1.zh: 太阳照亮整片平原，父亲又轻声把那句承诺肯定了一遍。

38.2.en: At noon one voice rose over the border market: the old farmer would [[claim:claim]] his apples were the sweetest of all.
38.2.zh: 正午，边境集市上有个嗓门格外响亮：老农一口咬定自家的苹果最甜。

38.3.en: A [[guard:guard]] came to [[proclaim:proclaim]] the new rules, and by the lamps of the second country we listened to all of them.
38.3.zh: 一名卫兵前来宣告新规矩，在第二个国家的灯下，我们从头听到了尾。

38.4.en: Half glad, half asleep after three countries, we sat in a [[state:state]] none of us could name.
38.4.zh: 走过三个国家，我们又高兴又犯困，坐在那里，那种状态谁也叫不出名字。

38.5.en: Father heard a [[guard:guard]] [[announce:announce]] each stop twice, his voice running ahead of the [[mist:mist]].
38.5.zh: 父亲听见卫兵把每个站名都念了两遍，声音跑在雾的前头。

39.0.en: Past midnight Father murmured that he still had one small thing to [[clarify:clarify]], and I covered him up.
39.0.zh: 过了午夜，父亲喃喃说还有一件小事要澄清，我给他把被子盖好。

39.1.en: Strange how [[quiet:quiet]] a morning ride home stays while Father counts every way strangers [[assist:assist]] us.
39.1.zh: 父亲细数着陌生人帮助过我们的种种方式，清晨的归途竟一直这样安静。

39.2.en: Village lights, the smell of home, and Father laughing about the [[aid:aid]] workers he once met on the road.
39.2.zh: 村里的灯火，家里的气味，还有父亲笑着讲起路上遇见的那几个救援人员。

39.3.en: At [[dawn:dawn]] the conductor asked the tall boys to [[encourage:encourage]] one another and clear the doorway for the old folks.
39.3.zh: 拂晓，列车员请高个男孩们互相鼓劲，给老人们腾出门口。

39.4.en: Over hot noodles, Father put on an important voice about the rules we must [[implement:implement]], and our neighbors [[burst:burst]] out laughing.
39.4.zh: 吃着热面，父亲板起一副要紧的腔调，说我们必须实施那些规矩，邻座都笑出了声。

39.5.en: Two tall cameras at the border [[monitor:monitor]] every train that waits by the wall.
39.5.zh: 边境上架着两台高高的摄像头，监控着每一列停在墙边的火车。

40.0.en: Father said that after our long [[night:night]] ride his heart would never [[admit:admit]] to worry again.
40.0.zh: 父亲说，熬过那趟长长的夜车，他的心里再也不会承认有什么忧愁了。

40.1.en: The queue moved slowly, so Father whispered to me about [[african:African]] drums.
40.1.zh: 队伍挪得很慢，父亲便凑过来低声给我讲非洲鼓。

40.2.en: The [[european:European]] trains on the old map looked smaller than ours, and Uncle laughed.
40.2.zh: 旧地图上那些欧洲火车看起来比我们的还小，叔叔看了直笑。

40.3.en: At [[sunrise:sunrise]] Father pointed at the far hills and taught me a [[latin:Latin]] word.
40.3.zh: 日出时分，父亲指着远处的山丘，教了我一个拉丁语词。

40.4.en: At the end he described a [[jewish:Jewish]] [[festival:festival]], where the whole family sat around one long table.
40.4.zh: 最后他描绘了一个犹太节日：全家人围着一张长桌坐下。

40.5.en: Near the noon exit of the border market, a smiling [[arabian:Arabian]] seller of dates said good morning to Father.
40.5.zh: 临近正午，在边境集市的出口附近，一个笑吟吟卖椰枣的阿拉伯人向父亲道了早安。

41.0.en: Nobody knew the man at our table was [[portuguese:Portuguese]] until he broke his bread for the kids.
41.0.zh: 直到他把面包掰开分给孩子们，我们才晓得同桌这位先生是葡萄牙人。

41.1.en: Even the old [[roman:Roman]] roads, Father said, were built to last a thousand years.
41.1.zh: 父亲说，就连古罗马的老路，当年也是照着能用一千年来修的。

41.2.en: An old [[russian:Russian]] song was how Father chose to [[describe:describe]] the [[mist:mist]] that morning.
41.2.zh: 那天早晨，父亲挑了一支老俄国民歌来形容那片雾。

41.3.en: The [[spanish:Spanish]] train was late, so Father moved our bags to a [[bench:bench]].
41.3.zh: 那趟西班牙列车晚点了，父亲把我们的行李搬到了长椅上。

41.4.en: Father timed the [[swiss:Swiss]] trains himself, and none of them ran late.
41.4.zh: 父亲亲自给瑞士列车掐了表，结果没有一趟晚点。

41.5.en: That [[night:night]] Father told a [[greek:Greek]] [[story:story]] about a king, and I fell asleep before the end.
41.5.zh: 那天晚上，父亲讲了一个关于国王的希腊故事，我还没听到结尾就睡着了。

42.0.en: The farmer across from us spoke a soft language that Father called [[italian:Italian]].
42.0.zh: 坐我们对面的农夫说一种很柔和的语言，父亲说那是意大利语。

42.1.en: He even copied a line from an old [[soviet:Soviet]] [[film:film]], which made the whole room laugh.
42.1.zh: 他甚至学了一句老苏联电影里的台词，把满屋子的人都逗笑了。

42.2.en: In his notebook Father sketched an [[indian:Indian]] [[temple:temple]] next to our [[trip:trip]] plan, a page for Mother.
42.2.zh: 父亲在本子上、我们的行程计划旁边勾了一座印度神庙，那一页是留给母亲的。

42.3.en: Half through his morning tea, Father was dreaming out loud about [[australia:Australia]] and its long sunny roads.
42.3.zh: 早茶喝到一半，父亲已经在出声憧憬澳大利亚，和那里晒满阳光的长路。

42.4.en: The green fields here, Father said, looked just like [[new zealand:New Zealand]], a country far to the south.
42.4.zh: 父亲说，这里绿色的田野很像新西兰，那个远在南方的国度。

42.5.en: Uncle once worked two winters in [[canada:Canada]], where the snow could cover a car.
42.5.zh: 叔叔曾在加拿大干过两个冬天，那里的雪能埋住一辆汽车。

43.0.en: A traveler from [[britain:Britain]] sang softly with us all the way to the village lights.
43.0.zh: 一位来自英国的旅人和我们轻声合唱，一直唱到望见村口的灯火。

43.1.en: My father chatted long with a kind old cook from [[france:France]] about [[snowy:snowy]] hills and warm village festivals.
43.1.zh: 父亲和一位来自法国的和善老厨师聊了很久，聊雪山，也聊热闹的乡村节庆。

43.2.en: Near the window a [[gentle:gentle]] girl from [[germany:Germany]] showed us photos of golden fields and laughing kids at home.
43.2.zh: 靠窗坐着一位温和的德国女孩，给我们看她家乡金色的田野和欢笑的孩子。

44.0.en: Old Lin dreamed of running a small corner shop, but as a new [[merchant:merchant]] he would face [[financial:financial]] [[pressure:pressure]] every day.
44.0.zh: 老林梦想经营一家街角小店，可作为一个新商人，他每天都得面对经济上的压力。

44.1.en: He rented the shop with his own small [[fund:fund]], and often would [[donate:donate]] warm food to the neighbors.
44.1.zh: 他用自己那点微薄的资金租下店面，还常常把热乎的饭菜送给邻居。

44.2.en: Kind neighbors [[endow:endowed]] the old house with a hope that went beyond any [[commercial:commercial]] plan.
44.2.zh: 好心的邻居们仿佛给老屋注入了希望，那远远超出了任何商业打算。

44.3.en: He did not [[advertise:advertise]] loudly, but wrote a warm [[slogan:slogan]] on the [[wooden:wooden]] door [[outside:outside]].
44.3.zh: 他没有大声做广告，只在外面的木门上写下一句暖心的标语。

44.4.en: Before the [[purchase:purchase]] of the shelves, he read every line of the [[lease:lease]] with great care.
44.4.zh: 在购置货架之前，他把租约里的每一条都仔仔细细读过。

44.5.en: He could barely [[afford:afford]] the [[first:first]] month, but he dreamed of the small joys a tiny [[retail:retail]] shop could give the street.
44.5.zh: 第一个月的开销他都勉强才负担得起，却梦想着一家小小的零售铺能给整条街带来细小的快乐。

45.0.en: The little [[grocery:grocery]] opened quietly, and he offered a small [[discount:discount]] to the old customers nearby.
45.0.zh: 小杂货店安安静静地开了张，他给附近的老顾客一点小小的折扣。

45.1.en: For the opening [[promotion:promotion]] he handed out [[paper:paper]] [[voucher:vouchers]] to the children playing [[outside:outside]].
45.1.zh: 开张促销那几天，他给在外面玩耍的孩子们发纸质代金券。

45.2.en: Old people brought [[paper:paper]] [[coupon:coupons]] and asked about the different [[currency:currencies]] their visiting relatives had brought with them.
45.2.zh: 老人们带来纸质优惠券，还打听起各家来访亲戚随身带来的不同货币。

45.3.en: Small things were [[exchange:exchanged]] with the neighbors, and a good story was sometimes [[swap:swapped]] for a smile.
45.3.zh: 小物件跟邻居们换来换去，一个好故事有时也能换回一个笑脸。

45.4.en: Every [[receipt:receipt]] was kept in a box, and he worried about any new [[levy:levy]] on small shops.
45.4.zh: 每张收据都收在盒子里，他担心的是对小店新征的任何一种税。

45.5.en: As he learned about [[tariff:tariffs]] on imported [[fruit:fruit]], his sense of [[duty:duty]] grew stronger each day.
45.5.zh: 随着他一点点弄懂进口水果的关税，他的责任感一天比一天强。

46.0.en: He feared that a rich landlord [[might:might]] [[impose:impose]] a high rent and quickly [[consume:consume]] the little money he had.
46.0.zh: 他担心有钱的房东会强加一笔高租金，很快耗光他仅有的一点钱。

46.1.en: Daily [[revenue:revenue]] was small, and the [[gross:gross]] [[total:total]] barely covered the water and light bills.
46.1.zh: 每天的营收很少，毛收入的总数刚够付水电费。

46.2.en: A wider [[recession:recession]] hung over the town and filled him with [[quiet:quiet]] [[depression:depression]] at [[night:night]].
46.2.zh: 一场更大的不景气笼罩着全镇，夜里他心里满是说不出的抑郁。

46.3.en: Yet a sudden shortage [[crisis:crisis]] shook his hope for [[stable:stable]] [[security:security]] in the cold winter.
46.3.zh: 偏偏一场突如其来的短缺危机，动摇了他在寒冬里求安稳保障的指望。

46.4.en: Friendship [[bond:bonds]] with the neighbors kept him going, despite the heavy [[debt:debt]] to his supplier.
46.4.zh: 和邻居们的情谊纽带支撑着他，尽管他还欠着供货商一笔重债。

46.5.en: Regular [[deficit:deficits]] piled up slowly, while rising [[inflation:inflation]] pushed prices higher each week.
46.5.zh: 一笔笔常规的亏空慢慢积起来，而不断上涨的通货膨胀一周比一周把价格推得更高。

47.0.en: He had hoped for price [[deflation:deflation]], but [[saw:saw]] his stored coins [[dwindle:dwindle]] day by day.
47.0.zh: 他本来盼着物价回落，可看着存下的硬币一天天减少。

47.1.en: Watching the [[weather:weather]] and the [[decrease:decrease]] in business, he chose to [[downsize:downsize]], closing earlier in the evening.
47.1.zh: 眼看着天气和生意一同转淡，他只好缩小规模，傍晚早早关了门。

47.2.en: He watched his hopes [[decline:decline]] as the daily stream of customers seemed to [[diminish:diminish]].
47.2.zh: 他看着自己的希望一点点落下去，每天来买东西的客人似乎也在减少。

47.3.en: He tried to [[reduce:reduce]] waste in the back room and [[increase:increase]] fresh [[fruit:fruit]] on the shelves.
47.3.zh: 他努力减少后屋的浪费，同时在货架上增加新鲜水果。

47.4.en: Every tiny [[increment:increment]] in visitors felt like warm [[growth:growth]] after the long cold spell.
47.4.zh: 客人每多来一点点，都像漫长寒潮之后的一阵暖意生长。

47.5.en: Costs continued to [[escalate:escalate]], so he dared not [[expand:expand]] the shop to the next door.
47.5.zh: 成本不断攀升，他不敢把店面扩展到隔壁去。

paraZh.36: 夜色进窗想夜市，主持人讲选票，父亲给我全新的视角与立场。
paraZh.37: 从山河里读前途，纸上写一行方针与家训，雨天翻菜单找蜂蜜。
paraZh.38: 日出发车父亲宣布启程，正午老农咬定苹果最甜，卫兵宣读新规。
paraZh.39: 午夜还想澄清小事，晨间数陌生人的帮助，拂晓让路，摄像头监视列车。
paraZh.40: 夜车后再无忧愁，排队聊非洲鼓，日出学拉丁词，正午阿拉伯摊主道早安。
paraZh.41: 掰面包分孩子才知是葡萄牙人，聊罗马古道，晚点搬行李上长椅，夜听希腊故事。
paraZh.42: 对面农夫说意大利语，学苏联电影台词逗笑满屋，聊澳、新西兰与加拿大。
paraZh.43: 英国旅人一路轻声唱，法国老厨师聊雪山节庆，德国女孩展示家乡照片。
paraZh.44: 老林梦想开街角小店，自掏资金租房，不吆喝只在木门写暖心标语。
paraZh.45: 小店安静开张让利老客，给孩子发代金券，收好每张收据，弄懂关税添责任。
paraZh.46: 怕房东强收高租，进账仅够水电，衰退与亏空压顶，唯邻里情谊支撑。
paraZh.47: 盼物价回落存钱却渐少，缩小规模减浪费多摆鲜果，成本攀升不敢扩张。
